questions.question:

When the mirror is placed to the right of the figure, the following changes occurs

 
• The arrow facing towards the North East will face towards the North West in the mirror image.
 
• Shaded Square, which is in the left side, will be appeared in the right side for the mirror image.
 
• Circle which is at the right side will be appeared at the left side for the mirror image.
 
• Vertical and Horizontal lines remain unchanged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5da33f68ecc9a8a7dfdcd2477a9197152d45c1edad67e1d3a58d4c7591770b6b.png]

questions.question:
Which letter will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

A, B, E, J, Q, ?
questions.solution:
According to the alphabetical position of the letters,

A + 1 = B

B + 3 = E

E + 5 = J

J + 7 = Q

Similarly,

Q + 9 = **Z**

Hence, **Z **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Find the missing number from the below options.

12 7 95

14 8 132

16 9 ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

In first row,

= (12)² - (7)²

= 144 - 49

= 95

In second row,

= (14)² - (8)²

= 196 - 64

= 132

Similarly, in the third row,

= (16)² - (9)²

= 256 - 81

= 175

Hence, 175 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Find the missing number from the below options.

19 78 20

25 144 47

16 ? 13
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

In the first row,

(19 + 20) × 2 = 78;

In the second row,

(25 + 47) × 2 = 144;

Similarly, in the third row,

(16 + 13) × 2 = **58**

Hence, 58 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Three of the following four words are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd word out.
questions.solution:
The word “Costly”, “Expensive”, and “Valuable” signifies the quality and the amount of money associated with the product. But the Word “Big” signifies the size of the products.

Hence, the word “Big” is the Odd one.

questions.question:
Select the word pair in which the two words are related in a same way as the two words in the following word-pair.

Season : Winter
questions.solution:
The word in the right side comes under the classification of word in the left side.

For example, winter is one of the types among many seasons.

Similarly, April is one among many months.

Hence, April is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statement to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some teachers are philosophers.

Some philosophers are writers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some writers are teachers.

II. No writer is a teacher.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e4ef9de1da0e90ae36fce3c475d7b940c22ed86c077ec43b508120da6587d6b.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some writers are teachers → False (It is possible but not definite.)

II. No writer is a teacher → False (It is possible but not definite.)

Both conclusions I and II forms complementary pair.

Hence, either conclusion I or II follows.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

8 × 2 + 5 - 16 ÷ 4 = 14
questions.solution:
According to BODMAS rule, the sequence of arithmetic operation will be Division, Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction.

8 × 2 ÷ 5 - 16 + 4 is not equal to 14

8 - 2 + 5 × 16 ÷ 4 is not equal to 14

8 ÷ 2 + 5 - 16 × 4 is not equal to 14

8 + 2 × 5 - 16 ÷ 4 is equal to 14

By interchanging x and +, we can make the equation correct.

Hence option 2 is correct.

questions.question: Nisha and Deepak are a married couple and have a daughter named Tanya. Currently, Deepak is 5 years older than Nisha and Nisha is thrice the age of Tanya. If Tanya is 10 years old, what was her father’s age at the time of his daughter’s birth?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of Tanya be X.

Given that X = 10

Nisha’s age = 3x

= 3 x 10 = 30

Deepak’s age = 30 + 5 = 35

Deepak‘s age at the time of Tanya’s birth = 35 - 10 = 25

Hence, 25 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Egypt

2. Africa

3. Great Pyramid

4. World

5. Giza
questions.solution:
Great Pyramid is located in Giza.

Giza is located in Egypt.

Egypt is located in Africa.

Africa is located in World.

Hence the logical and meaningful order is 3, 5, 1, 2, and 4.

questions.question: Three of the following four number-pairs are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
questions.solution:
In all options except’ 64 : 54’, the number in left side is the multiple of 8 and the number in the right side is multiple of 7.

In option 2, the number in the right side is not the multiple of 7.

Hence 64 : 54 is the odd one out.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

12 : 68 ∷ 21 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

(12 × 6) - (12 ÷ 3) = 68;

Similarly,

(21 × 6) - (21 ÷ 3) = 119

Hence, 119 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** The numbers are in the ratio of 3/17.

12/68 = 3/17

Similarly,

21/119 = 3/17.
